description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade routines for OpenWrt firmware, including functions for checking images, performing upgrades, and copying configuration data within a Linux environment. It is tailored for the bcm27xx architecture and includes logic for handling disk partitions and images during firmware upgrades.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the integrity and compatibility of an image before upgrading by comparing partition layouts.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade by writing images to partitions or entire disks, handling partition differences, and updating UUIDs.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to the device's boot partition.
